qa_pair.question: For pre-seeded session eval-01, the immutable MapLibre Style is version 8 with vector source basemap, inline GeoJSON source points containing two Point features, and layers background, roads, boundaries, and places. Use inline style_validate on that exact Style and read the session context resource. Are the validation result and context counts consistent? Answer True or False.

For pre-seeded session eval-02, the immutable version 8 Style has layers background, roads, boundaries, and places; roads is the only layer whose ID contains road. Use style_inspect with the context selection and style_search_layers with query road. What one layer ID is selected by both results?

For pre-seeded session eval-03, the immutable version 8 Style has background paint background-color #ffffff and roads paint line-color #336699. Search for road, then read both the roads and background layer resources. What is the roads line-color?

For pre-seeded session eval-04, the immutable version 8 Style has vector source basemap; layer roads uses source-layer transportation and layer boundaries uses source-layer boundaries. Use style_inspect with the sourceLayers selection for basemap and read the basemap source resource. Which source-layer name belongs to roads?

For pre-seeded session eval-05, the immutable version 8 Style contains inline GeoJSON source points whose FeatureCollection has exactly two Point features named Alpha and Beta. Use inline style_analyze_geojson on that exact FeatureCollection and validate the exact inline Style. What is the feature count?

For pre-seeded session eval-06, the immutable version 8 Style has inline GeoJSON source points containing exactly two Point features. Analyze that session source, then read both the points source resource and the complete style resource. What single geometry type is counted?

For pre-seeded session eval-07, the immutable version 8 Style has never been mutated after seeding. Use style_export and read the style resource for the same session, confirming the documents match. What is the current revision number?

For pre-seeded session eval-08, the immutable version 8 Style has sources basemap and points and layers background, roads, boundaries, and places. Read session metadata and context resources and use style_export. What is the layer count?

For pre-seeded session eval-09, the immutable version 8 Style has layer places backed by inline GeoJSON source points. Search for places, then join the matching layer resource with its source resource. What is the source ID?

For pre-seeded session eval-10, the immutable version 8 Style has four layers and roads is a line layer backed by basemap with source-layer transportation. Validate the session, read its context resource, and read the roads layer resource. Are all three facts consistent? Answer True or False.
